    The deleted-simple socle class #

    At a positive new mesh, the torsion-free quotient of the ambient Auslander--Reiten middle has a simple submodule supported at the deleted primitive idempotent. This produces the manuscript's nonzero map from the deleted simple and hence a nonzero connecting extension class.
